metadata.title: Seventies Studio Portrait with Script Header

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio trio portrait featuring a central figure behind a wooden chair frame, topped with wide-spanning monoline script.
triggerTerms: monoline script header over white background
central figure behind wooden chair frame
excludeWhen: busy or textured backgrounds are needed
modern digital sans-serif typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio composition featuring three individuals. The central figure is framed by the back of a rustic wooden chair, while two flanking figures lean in from the sides. The top of the frame is dominated by a wide, flowing monoline script that spans the entire width of the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by wooden chair geometry
Typography spanning the top horizontal margin
High-contrast subjects against a pure white void
coreInvariants: Rustic wooden chair back used as a framing device
Monolinear cursive script spanning the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tight cluster; central male figure at 60% height, flanking female figures at 40% height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark clothing of the central figure and the vertical lines of the wooden chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wide script at the top, moves down to the central face, then outward to the flanking subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subjects and behind the script.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and Dark Brown (Clothing and Hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard Yellow and Tan (Clothing and Wood)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with muted, earthy saturation in the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Earth tones: ochre, tan, dark brown

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected lowercase letters with elongated ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: T and O are oversized and gestural
D has a long, trailing horizontal tail

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in negative space above subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the large script with a tiny, all-caps sans-serif subtitle centered directly beneath it.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the personal, hand-drawn feel of the header.
Similar casual, connected flow but requires significant thinning.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three people against a pure white background. A man in a black shirt sits behind a simple wooden chair frame. A woman in a yellow shirt leans on the left, and another woman in a white shirt leans on the right. High-key lighting, 1970s style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a wide, thin monolinear cursive script across the top 15% of the image in dark grey. Add a very small, centered line of all-caps sans-serif text immediately below the script.

verificationChecks: Does the script span nearly the full width of the canvas?
Is the central figure framed by the chair back?
Is the stroke weight of the script consistent and thin?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script does not overlap the subjects' heads.
Ensure the wooden chair looks rustic and unpolished.
Verify the white background is blown out to pure white (#FFFFFF).
Confirm the typography is monolinear without thick/thin variation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Trio + High-Key White + Monoline Script Header + Framing Prop
